Messages.Author: Cantila
Messages.Body:
Does Narrow Minds affect the inferior version of for example
Telepathic Misdirection and MEE? (they're cards that can change the
target depending on the level you play it at)

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Telepathis Misdirection at inferior is not a card that changes the target of a
bleed, just as Skullduggery at pro is not a card that requires pre (so can be
played by an anarch without pre, for example).
